By The Pp, Assam

Page No.# 1/2 vs The State Of Assam on 22 May, 2023

1 

Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. M Kalita
Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam

BEFORE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANASH RANJAN PATHAK  ORDER 22-05-2023 Heard Mr. J. Hatimuria, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. M. P. Goswami,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.
By this application under Section 438 CrPC, the petitioners, namely, 1) Md. Safi Ahmed @ Safi Uddin, 2) Md. Maksad Khan and 3) Sri Chandrakanta Boruah apprehending their arrest is seeking p r e a r r e s t b a i l i n M o r a n P . S . C a s e N o . 2 5 / 2 0 2 3 r e g i s t e r e d u n d e r S e c t i o n s 120(B)/406/419/420/468/471 IPC.
On instructions of the petitioners, Mr. Hatimuria, learned counsel prays for withdrawal of this pre arrest bail application, to which, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam has no objection.
Prayer is allowed.
Accordingly, this pre arrest bail application stands dismissed, on being withdrawn.
If in the meanwhile, the case diary has been received, the same shall be returned to the concerned Investigating Officer forthwith.
